Opinion summarization aims at producing a summary for a set of subjective user reviews about an entity (i.e., a product, a service or a movie), which can help users quickly understand the entity.

We show the automatic metrics and human evaluation below. ROUGE Diversity (Div↓) uses self-BLEU   which measures BLEU scores of each generated sentence by considering others as reference. Aspect Coverage (AC) measures the overlapping of aspects in the gold summary and generated summary.

Human Evaluation. We randomly select 50, 32 (all test data) and 50 samples from the test sets of Yelp, Amazon and RT, respectively. We ask three human annotators, who are native or proficient English speakers to rank gold summary and summaries generated by OURS and TranSum under 5 aspects: Fluency (Flu.), Non-redundancy (NR.), Opinion Consistency (Cons.) and Overall.
